description: This file defines a custom Gson exclusion strategy that skips fields annotated with @JsonExclude during serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: JsonExcludeAnnotationBasedExclusionStrategy
classes.description: A strategy for Gson to skip fields annotated with @JsonExclude during JSON processing.

methods.name: shouldSkipField
methods.description: Determines whether a specific field should be skipped based on the presence of @JsonExclude annotation.

methods.name: shouldSkipClass
methods.description: Determines whether a class should be skipped; always returns false in this implementation.
